headline: Amdocs Shares Plunge in Premarket Amid T-Mobile Legal Dispute
summary: Amdocs shares plummeted over 40% in premarket trading on Wall Street to reach multi-year lows following a legal dispute with T-Mobile.
why: Software and IT service providers facing major customer disputes or contract terminations can experience severe equity valuation shocks.
